entries: send a voice note to your group chat saying 'I love you all' as dramatically as possible
post a story on Instagram or Snapchat of you doing any dance. Do it right now
call your most recent missed call back and tell them you butt-dialed them
let the person on your left change your wallpaper to whatever they want. It stays for the rest of the night
FaceTime or video call someone from your contacts. If they answer, say 'wrong number, sorry' and hang up
text 'omg I can't believe it' to your best friend with no context and show the group their response
send a GIF to the group chat right now. The group votes if it lands
text someone '👀' with no context and show the group their response
text 'Hey, are you awake?' to someone not in this room
call your mom on speaker and tell her you love her
text 'I need to tell you something' to someone not in this room and show the group their response
let the player to your right record a voice memo on your phone saying anything. It stays for the rest of the week
record yourself singing the chorus of the last song you listened to and send it to a friend
let whoever's sitting next to you post anything to your Instagram story. It stays up for at least an hour
open your keyboard and use whatever the top 5 emoji suggestions are in a single text to someone
let the person across from you scroll through your Spotify Liked Songs and defend whatever they land on
show the group your most recently used sticker and let them vote. Send the winner to someone not in this room
let the person on your left pick any contact. Send them a selfie right now
let the person to your right unfollow one person on any of your social media accounts
let the player across from you pick any emoji. Search your texts for it and read the first message that comes up
let whoever's sitting next to you AirDrop you anything and set it as your wallpaper for the rest of the night
let the person on your left pick a camera filter. Take a selfie with it and post it to your group chat
let the person on your left send one text to anyone in your contacts. You can't delete it for 10 minutes
let the player to your right scroll through your camera roll for 10 seconds and explain whatever photo they land on
let whoever's sitting next to you go live on any of your social media accounts for 10 seconds
let the person across from you scroll your saved Instagram posts for 15 seconds and explain whatever they pick
let the player on your left look through your Instagram following list for 10 seconds and explain whoever they pick
let the person to your right pick any video in your camera roll and play it for the group
let whoever's next to you pick any conversation in your messages and read the last 3 messages from it
text 'I had a dream about you last night' to someone not in this room
text your crush or partner 'I need to ask you something later' with no follow-up
send a heart emoji to whoever the group picks
text your ex 'hey' and show the group the sent message
let the person on your left type any search into your browser bar and show everyone the results
open your camera roll and show the group your most embarrassing photo from the last 30 days
text the last person you canceled plans on and tell them you miss them
open your most recent Uber or Lyft ride and read the driver rating you left out loud
pull up your Snapchat or Instagram story from the last time you were out and play it for the group
